decisions.measurement_route: sustained-attention/vigilance task with time-on-task performance
decisions.boundary: Sustained attention must not be inferred from initial hold/capture.

decisions.measurement_route: within-task time-on-task decrement under a validated vigilance paradigm
decisions.boundary: A decrement is task-sensitive and not a stable trait by itself.

decisions.measurement_route: choice-based expected-information-gain manipulation/estimate
decisions.boundary: Information gain is not identical to uncertainty magnitude.

decisions.measurement_route: information-choice valuation task or willingness-to-obtain information
decisions.boundary: Epistemic value must be distinguished from instrumental reward.

decisions.measurement_route: longitudinal/trial-level learning-progress estimate paired with exploration choice
decisions.boundary: Observed learning alone does not prove a subjective progress signal.

decisions.measurement_route: appraisal measure/manipulation for goal congruence
decisions.boundary: One appraisal cannot identify an emotion by itself.

decisions.measurement_route: certainty appraisal measure/manipulation
decisions.boundary: Certainty is distinct from confidence in source truth.

decisions.measurement_route: control/coping-potential appraisal measure
decisions.boundary: Perceived control is context- and event-specific.

decisions.measurement_route: agency/responsibility appraisal measure
decisions.boundary: Agency appraisal is not identical to moral blame.

decisions.measurement_route: salient-group norm measure/manipulation with identification context
decisions.boundary: Norms should not be inferred from majority behavior alone.

decisions.measurement_route: group-prototypicality measure relative to a salient group/category
decisions.boundary: Prototypicality is group-relative, not generic similarity.

decisions.measurement_route: validated perceived-authenticity/genuineness measure matched to source context
decisions.boundary: Authenticity is not objective truth or universal engagement value.

decisions.measurement_route: validated PSR dimension measuring real-life relationship intention
decisions.boundary: Desire for reciprocity is not evidence that reciprocity exists.

decisions.measurement_route: validated parasocial-intimacy/PSR dimension
decisions.boundary: Intimacy must not be inferred from familiarity/exposure frequency.

decisions.measurement_route: recipient-usefulness appraisal tied to a specific sharing decision
decisions.boundary: Usefulness is a motive/appraisal, not the share action itself.

decisions.measurement_route: motive-specific information-value sharing measure
decisions.boundary: Information-value motive may coexist with other motives.

decisions.measurement_route: privacy-risk/cost appraisal tied to audience and disclosure context
decisions.boundary: Privacy concern may not translate directly to behavior in every context.

decisions.measurement_route: reputational-risk/self-presentation appraisal tied to audience
decisions.boundary: Reputational risk is audience-dependent and distinct from privacy risk.

decisions.measurement_route: action-outcome knowledge or model-based transition/outcome representation task
decisions.boundary: Model-based metrics are approximations, not literal proof of a single neural system.

decisions.measurement_route: goal-directed sensitivity to current outcome values/action-outcome contingencies
decisions.boundary: Goal-directed control can coexist with habitual influences.
